newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rugby union-Queensland's Cannon outed for 15 matches.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Queensland's Cannon outed for 15 matches.

text.p: Queensland rugby union forward Brendan Cannon was suspended for 15 weeks on Sunday over a stomping charge from Saturday's spiteful Super 12 match against New South Wales, tournament officials said.

Reserve hooker Cannon was one of three players suspended by a hastily-convened Australian Rugby Union (ARU) judiciary panel, with New South Wales forward Richard Harry outed for three weeks and Queensland prop Dan Crowley banned for two.
